description: Implementation of Local Bank funded Kosgama - Avissawella Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-11-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, for the implementation of Kosgama - Avissawella Water Supply Project at a cost of Rs.1,062 million secured from local banks,  was approved by the Cabinet.
